snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn | 35-minute Gameplay
snippet.description:
Check out this 35-minute gameplay showcasing the beginning of Cronos: The New Dawn! Follow Traveler ND-3576 as she lands in the New Dawn district and is tasked with finding her mysterious Predecessor.
Cronos: The New Dawn is coming to PC, PlayStation5 and Xbox Series X/S this fall!
